secret_rules.label: GitHub personal access token (classic)
secret_rules.remediation: Revoke the token, rotate via a secret manager, and never commit it to source.

secret_rules.label: GitHub fine-grained personal access token
secret_rules.remediation: Revoke the token and rotate via a secret manager.

secret_rules.label: OpenAI-style API key
secret_rules.remediation: Revoke the key, rotate, and load it from environment or a vault.

secret_rules.label: AWS access key id
secret_rules.remediation: Revoke the IAM access key and rotate through IAM.

secret_rules.label: Slack token
secret_rules.remediation: Revoke the Slack token and rotate via the Slack admin.

secret_rules.label: Hardcoded credential assignment
secret_rules.remediation: Remove the literal; load credentials from environment or a vault.

ast_rules.remediation: Avoid eval(); parse or use a safe literal evaluator.
Avoid exec(); refactor to explicit calls.
Use a safe deserializer; pickle/yaml.load can execute arbitrary code.
Pass shell=False and an argv list; never interpolate untrusted input into a command string.
Use parameterized queries; never f-string/concatenate untrusted input into SQL.
